headline: Skydance to unify HBO Max and Paramount+ into one service
summary: Skydance plans to combine HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single streaming service, folding in Discovery+ as well, a move arstechnica says could lead to higher prices.

claims.statement: Skydance will combine HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single streaming service.

sources.quote: Skydance will combine HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single streaming service

claims.statement: The unified service will also fold in Discovery+.

sources.quote: HBO Max, Paramount+, and Discovery+ "will unify into a single service”

claims.statement: The combined service could lead to higher prices.
